d:
Bloomberg White House and National Security Editor Michelle Jamrisko tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump’s summit with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping reinforced his approach to diplomacy but left major questions unresolved over Ukraine and potential US security guarantees. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Jamrisko discusses European skepticism toward Putin, tensions within the Trump administration and Vice President JD Vance’s effort to distinguish his views as he looks toward 2028.
